# pvecli tag remove

Remove one or more tags from all VMs and CTs in the cluster.

```text
pvecli tag remove [TAG] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TAG` | Tag(s) - single or comma/semicolon-separated (e.g., web or web,db,cache). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
